text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Good day, Trainer. Did you have a refreshing break as well?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I couldn't feel better! I got my hair and tail treated. They're so sleek and shiny! ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: See for yourself! ♪ Hehe! Aren't they both styled gorgeously?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I always exude the aura of a first-rate Umamusume! ♪
